treasury.note: the Bruma treasury, where the Count paid the 2099 on 24 Oct 03:22Z (PROVEN); the Count's pack and bank untouched; nothing minted while the treasury holds 2095

count.note: the Count's pack, then his bank account; the rest minted (he holds a few hundred, so about 1,600 new gold while the 2099 stays in the treasury)

gold.note: The Steward traded 2099 to the Count on 24 Oct 03:22:14Z (2095 the player's) and the Count paid 2099 into the Bruma treasury the same minute (his bankLog and the player log item.bank, PROVEN; untagged, so never tithed). "order" is where the module takes it: inventory (his pack), bank (his account), treasury:bruma (the hold treasury, where the gold went). With no order in the plan (choice null) an apply is refused until the run file sets "goldOrder" to one of the choices: Jake picks. Fixed by the first gold step that is done. shortfall "mint" pays the player the part not found; "report" pays only what was taken.

notes.directToPackNote: the player's units the Steward took from the house (or the barrels) straight into his pack from 21 Oct 00:01Z on and still held at T0 (any of the base leaving his pack in between counted as the player's first); they follow the same trace from T0
notes.fungibleNote: taken although the trace counts them as his own put: plain units are alike, and what he still holds of the base afterwards is at least every unit he could ever have owned (PROVEN by count)
notes.unloggedMovesNote: moves a container summary shows and no item.move logged, put into the trace at the summary time
notes.liveMismatchesNote: live counts that differ from the trace after every logged move: a loss takes the player's units first; a rise is someone's own, or his put when his traced pack covers it (flagged likely)
notes.stewardPackLikelyNote: player units the trace leaves in the Steward's own pack (LIKELY his to hold under the order of units the trace assumes; some are LIKELY the player's).
